name: Highland wild dog
desc: Wild dogs live near the base of Puncak Jaya at roughly 3,900 to 4,200 m. New Guinea wild dogs eat marsupials, rodents, birds and fruit, and are said to steal eagle kills.
about: The New Guinea singing dog or New Guinea Highland dog is an ancient (basal) lineage of dog native to the New Guinea Highlands, on the island of New Guinea.
